blocker: Stock importer necessarily removes 5749 unreferenced original vertices; exact 1957891-vertex acceptance cannot pass.
scope: Read-only installed-source audit and bounded independent GLB index scan; no Blender process or import.
candidate_Blender_version_from_parent: 5.2.1; executable not launched by this audit

geometry_semantics.sorted_used_source_indices: np.unique defaults to sorted unique indices; vertex rows are selected from POSITION using those indices.
geometry_semantics.triangles_before_mesh_validate: For mode 4, triangle index stream is unchanged until it is remapped through inverse unique indices. Face order, corner order and winding are preserved by this NumPy route.
geometry_semantics.mesh_validate_caveat: The stock route subsequently calls mesh.validate(); final face count/order/multiplicity must be checked from the resulting mesh rather than assumed.
geometry_semantics.normal_axis_conversion: With debug_value != 100 and scene scale_length == 1, glTF (gx,gy,gz) becomes Blender (gx,-gz,gy); scale_length affects all positions otherwise.
geometry_semantics.bypasses_not_authorized: Custom extensions, monkeypatches, direct mesh construction, adding orphan vertices, changing debug conversion, modified GLB or relaxed source-count acceptance are outside this audit; none was used.
geometry_semantics.decision: Stop before Blender launch. Any future surface-only acceptance requires explicit approval to change the exact original-vertex-count criterion.

memory_projection_only.native_attribute_assumption: At most 3F generated edges; positions, face offsets, corner vertex/edge indices, edge pairs, BYTE_COLOR RGBA, material indices, sharp-face flags. Allocator overhead excluded.
memory_projection_only.unbounded_from_python_audit: Startup process, dependency graph, native edge hash/validation temporaries, threading/allocator overhead and serialization/compression are not bounded by these Python sources. The ledger is a planning projection, not an observed RSS/private-bytes result or a proof of a process-wide 6GiB upper bound.
memory_projection_only.supported_efficient_future_validation: Use RNA foreach_get into contiguous NumPy buffers and compare every row in bounded batches; do not materialize millions of Python vertex/polygon/color tuples. Core full geometry readback is ~23.5MB F32 positions + 50.1MB I32 loop indices + 2*16.7MB polygon start/size arrays. Full CORNER RGBA F32 readback is 200332032 bytes.

BYTE_COLOR_policy_not_runtime_qualified.installed_importer_contract: For this TRIANGLES primitive, COLOR_0 expands to CORNER RGBA float32, alpha=1, then stock importer creates Color as BYTE_COLOR and writes linear color using foreach_set.
BYTE_COLOR_policy_not_runtime_qualified.quantization_expected: Native linear-RGB-to-sRGB conversion followed by clamped nearest-byte conversion; alpha 1 becomes 255. Exact original float32 RGB bits cannot survive 8-bit storage.
BYTE_COLOR_policy_not_runtime_qualified.exactness_rule: If a future import is authorized, compare all resulting corner bytes exactly with expectations produced through the same installed native BYTE_COLOR color setter. Recover byte values through color_srgb and nearest integer of 255*value; require zero differing RGB/alpha bytes. Do not substitute a floating tolerance or allow one-byte mismatches.
BYTE_COLOR_policy_not_runtime_qualified.reason_native_oracle_required: Release native source has approximate SIMD/non-SIMD RGB conversion. A Python ideal IEC transfer plus rounding is not established as byte-identical at quantization boundaries. No native probe was run.
BYTE_COLOR_policy_not_runtime_qualified.color_getter_caution: color reads decoded scene-linear values; color_srgb exposes stored byte fractions. Verify data_type BYTE_COLOR, domain CORNER, loop count, alpha 255, active/render Color selection and actual vertex-color-to-material linkage separately.

primary_release_references.supports: BYTE_COLOR color setter/getter and byte-fraction color_srgb accessors.
Native vector RGB transfer uses approximations, with architecture-dependent SIMD path.
Unit-float-to-byte clamps and rounds to nearest byte; alpha is not sRGB transformed.
